info.title: Vetta API
info.description: Generated from the server's route table and the zod schemas its handlers validate with: every path, method, path parameter, the scope each route requires and the request body it accepts. Response bodies are not yet described.

apiKey.description: A scoped API key: `authorization: Bearer sk_…`.

202.description: Accepted — recorded, and the work runs after this response.

email.description: Where the member's verification link is sent.

role.description: primary for exactly one member; secondary for the rest.

is_responsible_party.description: true for exactly one member: the person the IRS contacts.

ownership_percent.description: Whole percent owned; all members sum to 100.

members.description: Every owner and officer to verify; each gets a hosted link to complete.

verification_id.description: The completed verification of the members forming it.

state.description: The US state to form in, as its two-letter code.

name_options.description: Up to three names in order of preference, without the LLC ending.

description.description: What the business does, in a sentence.

mailing_address.description: A US address where the company receives mail.

method.description: The HTTP method the endpoint expects; GET when omitted.
The HTTP method the endpoint expects; GET when omitted.

max_amount_micro_usd.description: Refuse to pay more than this, in micro-USD (1 USD = 1000000).

label.description: A name for the card, e.g. what it pays for.

load_micro_usd.description: The card's spending limit in micro-USD: $1 to $150, in whole cents.
The card's spending limit in micro-USD: $1 to $150, in whole cents.

markdown.description: The whole plan as Markdown; it replaces the version you read.

base_version.description: The version you last read, 0 for the first plan. A stale one is refused.

engine.description: `cad` runs a build123d Python script (precise parts); `blender` runs a Blender Python script (models, scenes).

script.description: The full Python script to run in the computer.

name.description: File name for the exports, without an extension: lowercase letters, digits, - and _.

export.description: File formats to export the result as.

render.description: Preview renders to make, or false for none.

views.description: Camera angles to render previews from.

size.description: Preview image width and height in pixels.

publish.description: Publish the exported files so they get shareable links.

niche.description: The topic or audience the character makes content for, e.g. 'budget travel for students'.

bio.description: A short backstory: who the character is, in a sentence or two.

voice.description: How the character talks: tone, pace, words they use or avoid.

wardrobe.description: What the character usually wears on screen.

hooks.description: Opening lines or catchphrases the character uses to start a video.

attested.description: true only when the person confirmed the photos are of them, or of someone who agreed to an AI likeness, and not a public figure.
